name: ShopMCP
description: ShopMCP gives Claude live, permission-scoped context from the ecommerce systems a brand already uses, then turns that evidence into operator-ready answers. Diagnose trading, product, marketing, retention and inventory issues across connected stores, analytics, ads, support and finance data. ShopMCP keeps accounts isolated, shows the evidence checked and data gaps, and uses independent runtime controls for consequential actions. The Claude directory connector launches read-only.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ShopMCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ShopMCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://my.shop-mcp.app/api/mcp/claude-directory. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ShopMCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ShopMCP lists 19 MCP tools, including shopmcp_aggregate_resource, shopmcp_ask, shopmcp_check_connections, shopmcp_describe_tool, shopmcp_execute_tool, shopmcp_export_resource, shopmcp_filter_resource, shopmcp_get_metric_baselines, shopmcp_get_operator_loop, shopmcp_get_playbook, shopmcp_get_playbook_runs, and shopmcp_get_resource.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ShopMCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to ShopMCP in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
ShopMCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ShopMCP is developed by ShopMCP. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
